walls.note: Nassaukade front, rectified whole by face-crops.ts (face-east-2 recording_2024-09-11_07-28-02_01946, sunlit, 40 px/m; face-east-3 TMX7316010203-001878_pano_0005_000020, 2020) plus the brief crop and its 2019 alt. Five window axes (1.28, 2.84, 4.40 | 7.26, 9.16 m from the Nassaukade 118 party wall, a downpipe and a pair of frieze consoles between the groups), three brick storeys over a timber shopfront: a café (awning, big window, door) on the left, Sameplace's door and blue boarded window on the right.

items.where: every storey: continuous white bands at the sill, transom and springing lines and one between storeys, across the orange-red brick
items.how: white ledge strips 5 cm proud across the piers, stopping at each window (storeys/band in sameplace-builder.ts)

items.where: first and second floor: segmental-arched windows with white arch rings and keystones; third floor flat white lintels with keystones; white sills; one transom per window
items.how: square-headed cut openings under a solid white head (0.25 m lintel block, 22 cm wider than the light, with a 0.12 m segmental crown and a small keystone; the glass is flat-topped, face-east-0), sill blocks, lintel slab on the third floor, white frame and transom bar

items.where: axis 2 (2.84 m), all three floors: French balconies with black iron bar rails
items.how: bronze floor slab and a rail of 11 bars with a top rail, 0.42 m out

items.where: over the third floor, 14.1-16.15 m: white architrave, frieze with a recessed panel and a small festoon over every axis, dentil band, projecting cornice
items.how: white face section with an architrave ledge, a proud panel and a swag-shaped poly over each axis, a dentil ledge and a 0.45 m cornice; dentils as one band

items.where: frieze over the downpipe between the window groups (5.8 m): a pair of white consoles
items.how: one white slab across the frieze height

items.where: over the cornice: slate mansard with two white dormers (axes 2 and 5) with pilasters, a two-light window and a segmental pediment
items.how: mansard swept along the three street faces with mitred corners; dormer boxes with pilasters, glazing and a segmental pediment (archFillOutline)

items.where: ground floor: dark brown timber shopfront with a three-row clerestory grid over both shops, black stone plinths under the piers
items.how: dark timber face section with cut doors, windows and grid clerestories (6x3 and 4x3 panes), stone plinth slabs

items.where: left shop: black awning box with a white top edge over the café window
items.how: bronze box with a white ledge, rolled up as in every photo

items.where: right shop (and two bays on the side street): the windows boarded in blue with Sameplace's mark and name in orange
items.how: blue recessed board in the window opening with an orange ring-and-cross mark and SAMEPLACE capitals in the 5x7 kit letters

items.where: café window and awning ends: small script name of the café

skip.note: the neighbouring café's name, a tenant mark

items.where: axis 2, first floor: a hanging flag over the balcony rail
rods over both dormers (lightning conductors or vent stacks, foreshortened in the crop)

skip.note: thin rods, not legible at ride distance

items.where: downpipe at 5.8 m from the cornice to the shop

walls.note: The cut-off corner (BAG ring vertices 2-3, 1.95 m) to the Tweede Hugo de Grootstraat: one window axis per storey with a French balcony on every floor, the café door with its signboard. Also the aimed brief view w01-89.thumb.

items.where: over the corner door at 2.35-3.07 m: brown board with cream capitals CAFE / SAMEPLACE (script-like serif in the photo)
items.how: dark board slab with CAFE and SAMEPLACE in the 5x7 kit capitals, cream, 5 cm proud of the board; the typeface is a decorative serif, approximated by block capitals

items.where: corner axis, all three floors: French balconies with iron rails
items.how: the same bar rail as the Nassaukade balconies, 1.25 m wide

items.where: corner door under the sign, with a 2x3 clerestory over the sign
items.how: cut door and grid opening in the timber section

walls.note: Tweede Hugo de Grootstraat side, face-crops.ts face-north-2 (2025-06-17) and face-north-0 (TMX7316010203-002055_pano_0000_001938, 2021-03-22). Four axes (1.65, 3.5, 5.35, 7.25 m from the corner); the two nearest the corner are painted-out (white blind) windows, with a billboard over the first-floor pair (its posters change: Aloha 2025, Ticketveiling 2021). Ground floor: three timber bays between brick piers (the BAG ring has them 0.1 m behind the pier faces), two with blue Sameplace boards, the third with a door and a window. One dormer over axis 3.

items.where: axes 1 and 2 (nearest the corner), all floors: windows painted out white inside their brick reveals, with the same arch rings and bands
items.how: shallow cut openings with a white back and no frame, same heads, sills and bands as the real windows

items.where: first floor over the two blind windows: a framed billboard about 3.3 x 2.7 m
items.how: black frame slab with a mid-tone blue-grey poster face and a deep pink strap along its foot (face-north-0); poster content changes, so no picture
items.note: Poster seen: 'Gezellig met je vader naar Aloha' (2025), Ticketveiling.nl (2021).

items.where: over axis 3: one pedimented dormer like the Nassaukade pair
ground floor: three timber bays with grid clerestories, blue boards, door and window, black stone plinths at the piers
items.how: dark timber section, three 4x3 grid clerestories, two blue boards with the mark, door and window

walls.note: Rear and party walls against Tweede Hugo de Grootstraat 1 (13.9 m) and Nassaukade 118: no photograph; plain brick above the neighbours, the low rear annex under its 3DBAG roof.
